notes.title: Version 1.7.0 & 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
- Added Korean language subtitle option
- Button images in “Control Config” shown in “Graphic Settings” have been modified to be displayed consistently on all menus
- Minor bug fixes
- Added Korean language subtitle option for digital artbook
- Added Korean language subtitle option for soundtrack titles

notes.title: Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE Plus EFIGS Patch & Discount

In commemoration of the release, both "Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE Plus" and "Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE Plus Deluxe Edition" will be available with a 10% discount during the promotional period.
